primitives.name: Rundown Thin-Fill Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Action (HP-16 step 0, before any PredExon code): make the Rundown thin-fill cheap enough to survive the day: call it only for games under `MIN_BOOKMAKERS`, NFL/NCAAF on game days only, one call per sport per cycle, 30-minute cooldown after a 429.
primitives.assumptions: API rate limits are deterministic and predictable within a given cadence window.
primitives.breakdown_regime: 429 HTTP status upon exceeding rate limit

layer2.mapping: Enforces temporal consistency in data ingestion by limiting calls to avoid quota exhaustion, enabling sustained edge detection.
layer2.telemetry: API response codes and call frequency metrics

primitives.name: Kalshi Fee Adjustment
primitives.verbatim_quote: A Kalshi quote used as a BOOK price for edge should subtract the taker fee at the ask, or it overstates edge by up to 1.75 cents at P 0.5.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'e_{\\text{adj}}': 'adjusted edge in dollars', 'p': 'market price in dollars', 'q': 'book price in dollars', 'f_{\\text{taker}}': 'taker fee in dollars'}
primitives.assumptions: Taker fee is constant and known per market.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Market price exceeds book price by less than fee

layer2.mapping: Maps market pricing to book pricing with fee correction, aligning with GSI's edge valuation framework.
layer2.telemetry: Fee-adjusted edge magnitude and consistency across markets

primitives.name: Model vs Close Disagreement Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: The brief already forbids the 0.58 fair-prob floor; add: never publish an NFL moneyline on a model-vs-close disagreement alone.
primitives.assumptions: Model disagreement without external context (venue, weather) is unreliable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Disagreement occurs but lacks supporting regime signal

layer2.mapping: Filters out spurious edge signals by requiring additional regime confirmation beyond model-book divergence.
layer2.telemetry: Number of filtered edges due to lack of regime confirmation

The thin-fill mechanism ensures that data ingestion remains sustainable by limiting calls to high-value scenarios only—specifically, games with fewer than MIN_BOOKMAKERS, restricted to NFL/NCAAF on game days, and spaced by a 30-minute cooldown post-429. This creates a bounded regime where data integrity is preserved while maximizing signal coverage. The Kalshi fee adjustment introduces a correction term to prevent overstatement of edge due to taker fees, which is critical for accurate risk-adjusted edge computation. The model vs close filter enforces that edge signals must be corroborated by external regime indicators such as venue disagreement or weather shocks, preventing false positives from noisy models.
